Charter correction 2026-08-29, silent upgrade per architect ruling: Station 3 restated from an empty centre to no manufactured form and a presence given rather than seized; Station 4 given its second failure mode, the fabricated absence; the Tacitus room separated into three causes. Seven sealed audit cycles total and two external-substrate passes. Codex siblings: Theological SC-099 CN-PSP-ELYON-CUSTODY-MASTER-01 and master INDEX 0708 sPSP-ELYON-CUSTODY-01, both still carrying the pre-correction charter language and owed a supersession. Zenodo related-identifier still names the superseded IA shell and is owed an update. Updated edition 2026-08-30: silent upgrades adding the external-witness layer (Merneptah, the Shasu of Yhw at Soleb, Timna, Deir Alla, the Iron I highland material, the suzerainty treaty form with its deposit clause, Jeroboam and 722, Josiah, Elephantine, teraphim at Nuzi, the 70 CE relocation and Yavneh, Bar Kokhba, Tel Dan, the Mesha stele read at full strength, the grant-versus-treaty distinction, the misharum edicts, and the first-fruits recitation), then a seven-round adversarial self-audit cycle closing SEALED-ROUND at controls three of three, six-register coverage, twelve findings earned and repaired, zero tier moves, two apertures open. Body grew 28,207 to 39,353 words, 30 to 40 pages. Git keeps the prior edition beside the updated one on the architect's ruling; Internet Archive replaced under the same identifier and same filename; Zenodo corrected in place under the same DOI with no version minted. Build engine pinned at weasyprint 65.1: releases 66.0 and above silently truncate this document after the first full-width table, exiting zero and throwing no error. Repair 2026-08-30b, architect-caught by reading the rendered PDF: Table 1 was broken in two in the source, a blank line and the Note paragraph interposed between the Masoretic row and the Samaritan row, so the builder closed the table early and rendered the orphan row as a headerless bar; the prose promised four witnesses and the table showed three. Defect predates the updated edition and is present in the original publication of 2026-08-28. Repaired by restoring the Samaritan row as row four and attaching the note contiguously as a table note. A scan of all seventeen table blocks in both editions found exactly one such orphan and no others. Recorded as a gap in the audit cycle: seven rounds across six registers prosecuted the Markdown and no register reads the rendered artifact.

Four routes refused with HTTP 403 'Bucket is locked for modifications', the legacy deposit bucket, the InvenioRDM draft delete, an in-place content overwrite, and an additional-file upload, all after a successful edit unlock returning 201. The draft was discarded and the record restored to state done with the DOI and the original file intact; no version was minted on the architect's ruling. That sets a per-record flag; until it is set every API route returns 403 Bucket is locked for modifications, which is what all four attempted routes returned across three sessions. The window is thirty days from publishing to unlock and forty-two days from unlocking to publish the change. Any future in-place correction must start at that dialog by hand before any automation runs.
